name: 48044 · Macomb, MI
findings: ZIP 48044 (Macomb) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48044 (Macomb) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
